note: Evergreen briefs for the film topic brain. Each entry is an idea plus a source trail, never prose. topic-brain.js checks every URL and promotes a topic only when at least five sources return HTTP 200; author.yml still builds and validates the evidence ledger. Add new topics with a category, a specific angle, and at least five live, independent sources.

topics.title: The Green Revolution: A Country Fed by a Seed
topics.why: A food-deficient country became a surplus one in a generation, and the argument over water, subsidies and who was left behind is still live.
topics.angle: A seed variety, a canal, a procurement price and a farmer's ledger. Explain the mechanism, not the triumphalism.

topics.title: Operation Flood: The Milk That Became Infrastructure
topics.why: A dairy cooperative turned a shortage into a national supply chain and became the template for rural market institutions.
topics.angle: A milk can, a collection centre, a cooperative ledger, and the argument over who owns the brand.

topics.title: Chipko: The Forest Held in Someone's Arms
topics.why: A local forest dispute became a national language for environmental rights and for who speaks for a resource.
topics.angle: The tree, the contractor's permit, the village assembly, and the question of what counts as a forest.

topics.title: The Right to Ask: How a File Became Public
topics.why: A procedural law changed who can demand a record and what a government must write down.
topics.angle: An application, a fee, a rejection letter, and the appellate order that followed.

topics.title: The Guarantee: A Job as a Legal Right
topics.why: A welfare promise written as an enforceable right, tested every year by wages, delay and the size of the rural workforce.
topics.angle: A job card, a muster roll, a bank passbook and the gap between the promise and the payment.

topics.title: Kesavananda Bharati: The Case That Limited Parliament
topics.why: A constitutional case turned the amending power into a limited power and gave India the basic-structure doctrine.
topics.angle: A petition, a thirteen-judge bench, a split verdict, and the line a parliament cannot cross.

topics.title: Mangalyaan: The Mars Orbiter Built on a Budget
topics.why: A first interplanetary attempt succeeded on a small budget and changed how a space programme was judged.
topics.angle: A launch window, an engine restart, a ground station and the cost of getting to Mars.

topics.title: Chandrayaan-3: The Landing That Was a Second Attempt
topics.why: A failed lander became the specification for the next one, and the south pole became a destination with a reason.
topics.angle: A velocity budget, a software fix, a lander leg, and what a second attempt inherits from a first failure.

topics.title: Project Tiger: Saving a Species by Counting It
topics.why: A conservation programme turned the tiger into a measure of forest health and state capacity.
topics.angle: A pugmark, a camera trap, a reserve boundary, and the villages inside it.

topics.title: Demonetisation: The Night the Notes Stopped Being Money
topics.why: A currency decision announced in a television address forced the country to re-price cash and became a lasting test of policy claims.
topics.angle: A currency note, a withdrawal limit, a bank queue and the difference between the announcement and the outcome.
